content.short: Cred Protocol provides credit risk infrastructure to quantify on-chain lending risk at scale.
content.description: Cred Protocol provides credit risk management infrastructure to quantify on-chain lending risk at scale. With more than 85 million active Ethereum wallets, only a small share has used DeFi loans, because protocols often cannot quantify risk and rely on over-collateralization for protection. Cred's products—credit score, credit report, and credit monitoring—deliver the infrastructure that puts risk quantification at the heart of lending offerings, helping lenders and platforms assess borrower risk more accurately.
